title: ASSISTENTE ADMINISTRATIVO - ANGLO | VAGA AFIRMATIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA
description:
A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atendimento secretaria escolar;
  • Atendimento ao Aluno e Pais;
  • Geração de documentos;
  • Emissões de boletos, recebimento de mensalidade, entrega de material.
  • Atendimento ao cliente (telefone, chat, e-mail e WhatsApp), assegurando uma experiência positiva em todas as interações;
  • Apoio em processos de captação, incluindo participação em eventos, feiras, visitas escolares e condução de tours;

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Médio Completo e/ou cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office Básico
  • Experiência prévia em atividades administrativas ou comerciais será um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de Pacote Office.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e organização.

Informações adicionais:

Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial na Anglo da Bela Cintra, 2° a 6° das 06h30 ás 15h30 com sábados alternados das 08h ás 14h.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.

Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.

Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).

Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.

Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.

Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.

Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.

Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.

Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.

Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.

Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.

Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.

Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
  • Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
  • Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: ReadMe, Notion, Git).

Ambiente dinâmico e diverso

Home Office

WellHub (gympass)

Convênio médico

Convênio odonto

VR/VA em cartão flexível

Verba de Incentivo Educação Anual

description:
Sobre a Datora

É uma empresa brasileira com mais de 30 anos de experiência no mercado de telecomunicações, reconhecida por sua trajetória de inovação e excelência.

Pioneira em soluções de VOIP, conectividade e mobilidade, a Datora atende empresas de diversos segmentos, com atuação no Brasil e presença internacional.

Com uma cultura voltada para a inovação, colaboração e desenvolvimento contínuo, nosso propósito é conectar pessoas e negócios de forma inteligente, segura e eficiente.

Acreditamos na força do trabalho em equipe e no poder das conexões. Por isso, nosso lema é: #JuntosSomosMelhores.

Conheça mais sobre a empresa:

Sobre o cargo:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Telecom Jr. para atuar no primeiro nível de atendimento técnico, com foco na resolução de demandas em suporte e atendimento ao cliente.

Esta posição será responsável por assumir o papel no suporte e atendimento, analisando e tratando eventos que impactam a operação dos clientes. Também prestará suporte por telefone e e-mail, interagindo com clientes, fornecedores e operadoras para garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs contratados e assegurar a qualidade e continuidade dos serviços prestados.

O que irá fazer:

• Atendimento ao cliente em primeiro nível (telefone e/ou e-mail).

• Gerenciamento e acompanhamento de chamados técnicos.

• Configuração e correção de problemas em serviços de voz.

Garantir a satisfação com clientes e fornecedores.

O que precisa ter:

•Formação Superior incompleta - Curso técnico em área de tecnologia (Telecom, Redes de Computadores, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação ou correlatos).

•Idiomas: Inglês intermediário

•Conhecimentos básicos em protocolos de rede (IP, TCP/UDP);

•Fundamentos básicos de VoIP/SIP;

Local e horário:

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido – São Paulo/SP

Jornada: Seg a sexta de 08h00 às 17h48 ou das 09h00 às 18h48

O que oferecemos:

• VR (Vale Refeição também para os dias de Home Office), VA e Gratificação de Férias no VR/VA.

• Assistência Médica, Odontológica e seguro de vida.

• PPR (Programa de Participação por Resultados)

• Flexibilidade: modelo híbrido com 3 dias em Home office

• Bem-Estar: Wellhub (GymPass), frutas no escritório e o programa Elleva (acompanhamento de equipe multidisciplinar de nutricionista, educador físico e psicólogo), convênio farmácia e auxílio medicamentos para patologias graves.

• Auxílio PCD para dependentes

• Vale-transporte, reembolso de estacionamento ou fretado.

• Reconhecimento: Prêmios por tempo de trabalho na empresa e reconhecimento por desempenho no trabalho.

• Incentivo ao desenvolvimento por meio de Bolsa de Estudos.

• Empréstimos consignados

• Day off de aniversário e gratificação no Flash de aniversário.

title: Especialista de RH
description:
No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como Especialista de Recursos Humanos para se juntar à nossa equipe em Praia do Forte . Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
  • Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
  • Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
  • Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).

Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)

Quais serão suas principais funções?

Recrutamento e Seleção

  • Condução e coordenação de processos seletivos para cargos de gerência e vice-diretoria.
  • Auxílio e suporte estratégico às equipes de RH e gestão nas atividades de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Garantia do alinhamento dos processos de seleção com os objetivos organizacionais.

Treinamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Análise de Necessidades de Treinamento: Realizar análise aprofundada de lacunas de habilidades, conduzir entrevistas e analisar dados de desempenho para identificar necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação.
  • Desenvolvimento de Programas de Treinamento: Ser responsável pelo processo de Indução de novos colaboradores, projetar e implementar programas personalizados (como o PDL), criar conteúdos inovadores (incluindo manuais e vídeos) e adotar metodologias como gamificação e simulações.
  • Implementação de Treinamentos: Coordenar a logística, facilitar os treinamentos e fornecer feedback contínuo.
  • Avaliação e Relatórios: Medir a eficácia dos programas utilizando KPIs, analisar dados e apresentar relatórios detalhados sobre o impacto nos objetivos organizacionais.

Programas e Gestão de Pessoas

  • Programa de Acompanhamento de Novos Colaboradores: Acompanhar o desempenho, fornecer suporte e feedback regular, e avaliar periodicamente a eficácia do programa de integração.
  • Programa de Indução (onboarding)
  • Programas do RH (Ouvidoria e Comitê da Diversidade): Gerenciar e analisar demandas da ouvidoria (RH com Você!), garantindo confidencialidade e elaborando relatórios de melhorias, e acompanhar as reuniões do Comitê da Diversidade.
  • Gestão de Desligamento e Retenção: Conduzir entrevistas de desligamento para análise de fatores de saída e desenvolver/implementar estratégias de retenção de talentos e engajamento.
  • Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Gestão de Desempenho: Mapear necessidades de T&D, conduzir programas de desenvolvimento de carreira e atuar como consultor estratégico para a liderança.
  • Indicadores de Desempenho e Relatórios: Acompanhar KPIs de recrutamento, seleção, desenvolvimento e retenção, e gerar relatórios analíticos para a liderança.

O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?

A pessoa ideal para este cargo possui excelentes habilidades de trabalho em equipe, é um bom comunicador. Tem capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia e rapidez na execução de processos. Possui capacidade de análise, habilidade de estruturar, sintetizar o conteúdo e montar apresentações harmoniosas e impactantes. É flexível e adaptável às novas circunstâncias da empresa e às diferentes mudanças organizacionais e possuir também as seguintes competências:

  • Formação: Graduação Psicologia
  • Experiência: De 3 a 4 anos em funções similares
  • Planejamento e Organização
  • Gestão de Pessoas
  • Pacote Google Workspace
  • Processos de Recrutamento e Seleção
  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento
  • Cargos, Carreira e Remuneração
  • Atenção Distribuída

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável.
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo, com benefícios atrativos.
  • Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial e crescer profissionalmente

Overview

The SAP AMS Project Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of SAP Application Management Services across multiple modules and business areas. This role oversees incident, problem, change, and enhancement management, ensuring compliance with SLAs, high-quality service delivery, and alignment with business objectives. The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

Service & Project Delivery

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Coordinate with SAP Basis, Functional, and Technical teams to resolve issues and deliver solutions.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.

Team & Vendor Coordination

Manage onshore/offshore AMS delivery teams across SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.).

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.g., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).

Governance, Reporting & Financials

Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly service performance reports.

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Recommend SAP process improvements and automation opportunities.

Support migration, upgrades, or transition projects (e.g., ECC to S/4HANA).

Drive adoption of ITIL best practices, Agile, or DevOps in SAP AMS delivery.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.

7+ years of experience in SAP project/AMS management.

Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

Proven track record in managing global/onshore-offshore delivery models.

Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.

Key Competencies

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: Engenheiro de controle
description:
About Woodgrove

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.

All resumes must be in english.

Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.g., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

Are you a scientist at heart, passionate about genomics and the power of technology to transform healthcare?

At MGI , we combine scientific excellence with innovation to redefine what’s possible in genetic sequencing and automation.

We’re seeking a NGS Technical Sales Specialist who blends a strong scientific foundation with a consultative commercial mindset — someone who can speak the language of researchers, understand their challenges, and guide them toward solutions that accelerate discovery.

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

Reporting & Planning

  • Driven by the opportunity to make genomics more accessible and impactful for all.

Scientific Expertise

  • Solid understanding of genomics, molecular biology, or biotechnology .

Commercial Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in life science sales, business development, or field-based scientific roles .

MGI is a global leader in genomics innovation, delivering advanced sequencing and automation solutions that empower scientists and healthcare professionals worldwide.

Our mission is to make high-quality, affordable genomics accessible to all — enabling discoveries that improve lives and transform the future of medicine.

Join us and help shape the next generation of genomics.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Selettra - Interoperabilidade na Robótica Móvel | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Transformar a automação industrial por meio da inovação é o que impulsiona a Selettra Automação e Robótica — e você pode fazer parte dessa evolução. Estamos em busca de profissionais proativos, analíticos e comprometidos com resultados para integrar um projeto desafiador voltado à padronização e integração de sistemas robóticos. O projeto visa tornar os processos mais inteligentes, eficientes e colaborativos, contribuindo para a modernização do ambiente fabril. Se você busca aplicar seus conhecimentos em um cenário dinâmico, com foco em inovação, conectividade e impacto real na transformação da indústria, essa vaga é para você.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em: Engenharias relacionadas com a área de automação industrial (Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica),

Doutorado em: Engenharias relacionadas ao tema de sistemas da informação (Computação, Sistemas da informação, Software).

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Interoperabilidade na Robótica Móvel

Principais Atividades:

· Desenvolvimento de aplicações para controle e coordenação de robôs móveis

· Integração de sistemas de localização (SLAM) e navegação autônoma

· Programação de CLPs e interfaces homem-máquina (IHMs)

· Implementação de sistemas de comunicação entre diferentes robôs e servidores

· Testes e validação de desempenho em ambientes industriais

Conhecimento necessário:

· Desenvolvimento de aplicações com CLPs e IHMs (Controladores Lógicos Programáveis e Interfaces Homem Máquina);

· Desenvolvimento de aplicações com sistemas Linux e integração via Docker;

· Capacitação em sistemas de troca de dados industriais e redes de comunicação;

· Capacitação em linguagens de programação de alto nível como C++, C#, Phyton e Java;

· Algoritmos de planejamento de trajetória (Djikstra, Star);

Conhecimento desejável:

· Desenvolvimento de aplicações com sistemas robóticos e controles via SLAM (Localização e Mapeamento Simultâneos);

· Desenvolvimento de aplicações com disposição a Machine Learning (Aprendizado de máquina);

· Capacitação em desenvolvimento de interfaces de operação;

· Conhecimento em sistemas multirobôs;

· Conhecimentos em AGVs e AMRs;

Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.

title: Tech Lead (Chatbot Development)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.

Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.

Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.

  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

description:

This role is central to delivering high-quality customer service within a 24/7 operational environment in the iGaming and digital entertainment industry. The position requires strong leadership, the ability to manage escalations, and a solid understanding of support operations in a fast-paced setting.

  • Support the distribution and implementation of updated training materials, tools, and process documentation.

  • Experience in a supervisory or leadership role within a customer support environment, ideally in iGaming, fintech, or digital entertainment.

  • Strong knowledge of support processes, quality monitoring, and performance tracking.
  • Comfortable making quick decisions and resolving urgent, high-impact support issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Project coordination or cross-functional team experience is considered an advantage.

Key Attributes

  • Confident and supportive leadership style.
  • Calm under pressure with a proactive, solution-focused mindset.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. title: Especialista de Relações Trabalhistas (Consultivo)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Atuar na análise da CLT e demais normas legais, acompanhando atualizações legislativas e garantindo conformidade nas práticas da empresa.
  • Elaborar, revisar e orientar sobre contratos de diferentes naturezas (efetivos, temporários, terceirizados), avaliando riscos legais e propondo ajustes.
  • Identificar práticas internas com potencial de gerar passivos, propor ações corretivas com foco na causa raiz e apoiar na criação de políticas internas.
  • Responsável pela gestão de cotas legais, afastamentos, FAP, benefícios previdenciários (como auxílio-doença e acidente de trabalho), além da padronização de processos entre unidades.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos voltados à legislação trabalhista e boas práticas, promovendo conhecimento e segurança jurídica entre líderes.
  • Ser referência técnica para áreas internas, oferecendo suporte consultivo em decisões que envolvam relações trabalhistas e contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Direito.
  • Pós-graduação em Direito do Trabalho ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida na área consultiva, com foco em prevenção de passivos trabalhistas.
  • Conhecimento profundo da legislação trabalhista e normas correlatas.
  • Vivência em gestão de cotas legais, afastamentos, FAP e benefícios previdenciários.
  • Habilidade para atuar de forma estratégica, com visão preventiva e orientação para negócios.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido em Indaiatuba/SP e realizar viagens às unidades de negócio.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +860 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 38 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente. e evoluir constantemente.

title: Plant Manager. Cabo de Santo Agostinho.
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin Brazil: Where purpose comes to life.

You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.

Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It’s time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to join us at Cabo de Santo Agostinho, Pernambuco, Brazil, in the Suape industrial complex . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

About the role:

The plant manager is responsible for managing the daily operations of the plant . This includes planning and coordinating production activities, managing a team of production department heads, supervisors and workers, and ensuring that the plant operates safely and efficiently. The production plant manager will also be responsible for controlling plant costs, improving production efficiency, and establishing and maintaining relationships with suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee plant operations such as budget, production schedule and stock.
  • Analyze production costs and inventory to establish areas for improvements
  • Ensure adherence to rules and workplace policies and HSE.
  • Lead improvement initiatives as aligned with global guidance , such as Lean and Operational Excellence , and other projects to improve quality, reduce costs, improve OEE, save time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or relevant field. (Nice to have: Lean Six Sigma certification)
  • 5+ years of experience in field as a Plan Manager in manufacturing (i n Plastic transformation processes).
  • Professional English level ( is a key requirement), the interviews will be in English
  • Experience in plant management and manufacturing operations, budget, Strong communication, management and supervisory skills.
  • The candidate will also have an ability to follow safety and compliance guidelines diligently in order to create a healthy work environment for all employees.

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Workspaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

description:

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .

In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.

Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.

The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.

3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.

4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.

5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.

6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.

7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).

Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers

in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.

SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.

Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.

In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.

Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Remote Data Entry Coordinator (Food Products)
description:
Data Entry Assistant — Pilot R&D (Remote, Full-Time)

This role requires English proficiency , both written and spoken.

The Vision

At Pilot R&D , ingredients are the foundation of everything we do. As a culinary innovation and product development company, we help food and beverage brands bring their ideas to life — from cookies to kombucha. Behind every successful recipe is accurate, reliable data.

Accurate ingredient data powers all our work — and you’ll play a key role in keeping our internal database (The Walk-In) clean, organized, and reliable as we work across dozens of fast-moving projects.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a detail-driven, tech-savvy, and proactive person who enjoys structured work, organizing information, and solving small data puzzles.

If you love accuracy, can spot inconsistencies quickly, and enjoy turning messy inputs into clean, precise data — this role will fit you perfectly.

You’ll support our Ingredient Sourcing team by reviewing supplier emails, extracting critical details (pricing, MOQs, certifications, etc.), and entering them into our system with accuracy and consistency.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-moving, innovative food and beverage development company working with top industry brands.
  • Join a small, collaborative team that values communication, curiosity, and growth.
  • Play a key role in shaping a new, foundational position within the company — you’ll help define what great data accuracy looks like for Pilot R&D.
  • Work remotely and independently , while still being connected daily through Slack and team check-ins.

Role Responsibilities

  • Enter all ingredient information into The Walk-In , our internal platform.
  • Upload supporting documents such as specification sheets, nutritional facts, GRAS and non-GMO statements, and certifications.
  • Input supplier data: pricing tiers, minimum order quantities, lead times, and FOB locations.
  • Set up new supplier profiles and maintain contact information.
  • Identify missing information and coordinate with the Sourcing Manager and Coordinator to complete data entries.
  • Perform regular data cleanup and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Collaborate closely with the sourcing team to ensure smooth data flow and transparency.

Skills & Experience

Must Have:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and reading English skills.
  • Reliable communication and responsiveness during 9 AM–5 PM PST business hours.
  • Comfortable interpreting information from emails and attachments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office .
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable following structured processes.
  • Tech-comfortable and willing to learn internal tools quickly.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Excel/Google Sheets or database tools.
  • Prior exposure to purchasing, procurement, or ingredient sourcing .
  • Background in food science, nutrition, chemistry, biology, or lab work.
  • Basic knowledge of coding or systems integration.
  • Familiarity with metric units .

Our Values

At Pilot R&D, our work blends innovation and science with a spirit of integrity and collaboration . We value clear communication, honest feedback, and building relationships — with our partners, clients, and team members. We believe in working hard, staying curious, and enjoying the process — after all, we’re making food for a living.

Compensation & Employment Type

Type: Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Remote (LATAM preferred)

Hours: 9 AM – 5 PM PST

Compensation: Starting at $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience)

Timeline: Hiring within 30–90 days

Application Process

Please email the following to Maria+ :

Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.DataEntry.pdf)

Cover Letter , including:

a) What interests you about working with Pilot R&D and this data-focused role

b) Specific experiences that show your attention to detail, organization, and reliability

c) How you stay focused and accurate when doing repetitive or technical work

d) What you enjoy doing outside of work

Well-structured, thoughtful applications will stand out. If you have any questions about the role or responsibilities, feel free to include them in your message.

Procuramos profissionais que queiram se reinventar a cada dia, que queiram enfrentar desafios em seu DNA e que sejam apaixonados por trabalhar com tecnologia/cibersegurança. Isso nos torna únicos e autênticos.

O que buscamos?

Procuramos um profissional Arquiteto SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) SR , para compor nosso time.

O que vai fazer?

  • Criar arquiteturas escaláveis e altamente disponíveis, considerando tolerância a falhas, balanceamento de carga e redundância.
  • Adotar práticas de chaos engineering para validar a resiliência da infraestrutura.
  • Atuar com automação e infraestrutura como Código (IaC)
  • Definir padrões de automação para provisionamento, configuração e gerenciamento de infraestrutura.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes e Helm.
  • Projetar estratégias de monitoramento proativo usando Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack e outras ferramentas.
  • Criar SLOs (Service Level Objectives), SLIs (Service Level Indicators) e SLAs (Service Level Agreements) para medir a confiabilidade do sistema.
  • Criar processos para resolução rápida de incidentes e resposta a falhas.
  • Desenvolver playbooks e runbooks para automação da resposta a incidentes.
  • Trabalhar na eficiência de uso de recursos, evitando desperdícios na nuvem e melhorando o desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de FinOps para otimizar custos de infraestrutura.
  • Fomentar práticas de CI/CD e integração contínua com pipelines automatizados.
  • Definir processos para rollback seguro, feature flags e testes em produção.

O que é necessário?

  • Experiência como SRE, com ampla vivência em ferramentas de observabilidade, principalmente o Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento em Práticas de FinOps com foco em otimização de custos e previsões de produtos;
  • Atuação com indicadores Golden Signals ou Page Status;
  • Habituado em responder a incidentes críticos e propor ações preventivas para evitar recorrência (Postmortem / RCA);
  • Atuação anterior como DevOps ou funções similares;
  • Conhecimento em ambiente de Cloud (AWS);
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação e similares, como DQL (Data Query Language) que é subconjunto da SQL (Structured Query Language).
  • Formação: Superior em tecnologia ou áreas relacionadas.

Modalidade: Atuação presencial, 3x por semana na Região do Morumbi em São Paulo

Modelo de contratação: CLT

title: Analista Torre Controle Manutenção JR (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Torre Controle Manutenção JR para atuar no nosso time COA.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Acompanhar o ciclo completo das ordens de serviço, desde a abertura até o encerramento;

Monitorar status dos equipamentos e atualizações diárias, mantendo precisão nas informações;

Manter comunicação constante com as equipes de campo por meio de rádio, WhatsApp, e-mail e celular;

Dar visibilidade às manutenções pendentes de execução para que as unidades, com base na criticidade e urgência, tratem os temas de forma eficiente;

Monitorar e acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à manutenção, como tempo de parada, custos e eficiência dos reparos.

Quais os requisitos?

Ensino médio completo;

Cursando técnico/superior será um diferencial;

Conhecimento em SAP, Solinftec, Gatec, PowerApps, Logtrac, Power BI e Sistema de Gestão de Ordens de Serviços;

Experiência em planejamento de manutenção, oficina automotiva, gestão de peças e análise de dados;

Disponibilidade para turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Contract CRA Project - 40 hours per week 1 year contract.

Seizure or Epilepsy - CNS

Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to monitor and manage Phase 2 Seizure study clinical trials. The CRA will ensure the trial is conducted in compliance with regulatory standards, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and the study protocol. This position involves collaborating with investigators, site personnel, and cross-functional teams to ensure the safety and well-being of participants in early-phase clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Site Management and Monitoring:
  • Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits.
  • Ensure proper site adherence to protocols, GCP, and regulatory requirements.
  • Verify and ensure accurate data collection and reporting.
  • Assess site performance and provide corrective actions if necessary.
  • Regulatory Compliance:
  • Ensure all clinical trial documentation is maintained according to regulatory guidelines.
  • Review informed consent documents and confirm proper consenting procedures.
  • Collaborate with regulatory teams to ensure timely submissions and approvals.
  • Safety and Data Management:
  • Monitor and report adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), and dose-limiting toxicities.
  • Validate source data and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Ensure timely and accurate documentation of clinical trial data in electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
  • Build and maintain relationships with study investigators and site staff.
  • Communicate study updates and findings to study sponsors and internal teams.
  • Provide training to site personnel on study protocols, procedures, and GCP compliance.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences , Nursing , or a related field.
  • At least 2-4 years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate in oncology trials, with preference for Phase 2 experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) , FDA regulations, and ICH guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) systems and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in early-phase oncology trials (e.g., dose escalation studies, first-in-human trials).
  • Strong understanding of pharmacokinetics (PK) and pharmacodynamics (PD) assessments.
  • Certification as a Clinical Research Professional (CCRA) is a plus.

title: Químico (a) laboratório pesquisa e desenvolvimento

description:

A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Fortalecer a área como um pilar estratégico dentro do Grupo Iguatemi, consolidando sua posição como uma das referências formais em inovação.

Garantir o NOI dos shoppings e o EBITDA corporativo por meio de uma curadoria assertiva de lojas e marcas para todos os malls e para o Iguatemi 365, orientando as decisões a partir dos quatro pilares da área: inteligência, inovação, planejamento e relacionamento.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Fazer o planejamento anual dos shoppings para definição das prioridades estratégicas (principais oportunidades e desafios), diagnóstico do mix ideal de lojas, mapeamento de marcas (considerando posicionamento, faixa etária e estilo) e vocação, sempre alinhadas com as principais tendências globais e que possuem sinergia com o nosso negócio;

Desenvolver operações exclusivas para os shoppings do grupo e garantir o diferencial e melhor experiência para o consumidor, além da integridade dos corredores estratégicos, áreas que definem a identidade e posicionamento de cada shopping representando parte dos atributos que compõem e reforçam a marca Iguatemi;

Desenvolver estudos de grupos econômicos para analisar presença geográfica das marcas, verificar oportunidades em nossos malls, possíveis parcerias com outros empreendedores, infrações cometidas, além de mapear pleitos e concessões;

Desenvolvimento de agenda estratégica de grupos econômicos com o objetivo de formar negociações e repassar decisões para equipe comercial elaborar propostas. Além disso, a gerência é responsável por definir também as estratégicas de expansão dos lojistas considerando as informações do acompanhamento da performance de vendas e visitas mensais à concorrência.

Garantir o atingimento do NOI / receita dos seus shoppings através da efetividade das iniciativas propostas no PIX e desdobradas no 5YP e 3YP com trocas de lojas efetivas (sales spread positivo), participação ativa no orçamento anual dos shoppings, curva de entrada e saída de lojas, definição de allowance e expectativa de vendas.

title: Coordenador de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente

Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior

INGLES FLUENTE
